meta.notes: Upcoming, dated family events kept separate from map pins. Confirm times, access, and weather with the linked organizer before heading out.

events.title: Lakewood Cider Days
events.time: Sat 10:00 AM–5:00 PM · Sun 10:00 AM–4:00 PM
events.note: Cider pressing, vintage tractors, wagon rides, and family activities; verify tickets and pricing.
events.source: City of Lakewood / Days.in.denver Fall guide

events.title: Pumpkin Fest
events.note: Free pancakes, games, live music, and fall fun; no reservation listed.
events.source: Prospect Recreation / Days.in.denver

events.title: Boo at the Zoo
events.note: Remaining nights Oct 9–11, 16–18, 23–25, 30; Oct 31 is the sensory-friendly night. Nine candy stations, friendly cryptid characters, Wild Fall Market. Kids 2 and under free ($5 optional Lil' Boo Bag); adult $25.95 value nights (Oct 9–11), $27.95 later. Popular nights sell out. Early arrival suits nap/bedtime.
events.source: Days.in.denver, Colorado Mama Life, Little Rad Adventure (IG Oct 8–9); denverzoo.org

events.title: SCFD Free Day at the Forney Museum
events.note: Free admission day; trains, cars, and big vehicles. Listed in Days.in.denver’s October free museum days reel.
events.source: Forney Museum / Days.in.denver

events.title: 2nd Saturday at CSU Spur: Día de los Muertos
events.note: Free, family-friendly 2nd Saturday; October activities may be announced closer to the date.
events.source: CSU Spur

events.title: Fall Festival at Giggling Life Care Farm
events.note: Ticketed farm festival with animals, hay ride, crafts, and pumpkin; code coloradokid5 was listed for $5 off per person.
events.source: Colorado Kids Explore / Giggling Life Care Farm

events.title: Free admission day: Fire Safety & Prevention Week
events.note: Free museum admission for Fire Safety & Prevention Week; check the museum before going.
events.source: Denver Firefighters Museum

events.title: SCFD Free Day: OUT! at the Museum
events.note: Free general admission, no tickets needed; walk up. Planetarium and special exhibits cost extra. Nature Play Park out back is free anyway. Expect crowds; go at opening.
events.source: Denver Museum of Nature & Science / Days.in.denver

events.title: Spooky Sweets Stroll
events.place: Orchard Town Center, 14697 Delaware St, Westminster
events.note: Free, no RSVP. Trick-or-treat at 50+ shops, free face painting and games, live DJ; pumpkin decorating for a $5–$10 donation (Food for Hope).
events.source: Colorado Mama Life (IG Oct 7, NORTH edition); theorchardtowncenter.com

events.title: Trunk-or-Treat + Outdoor Movie: Monsters vs. Aliens
events.note: Free family evening; bring blankets or lawn chairs. Trunk-or-treat starts at gate opening.
events.source: Infinity Park at Glendale

events.title: Harvest Haunt Express
events.note: Halloween weekend at the train museum. Check the museum site for tickets and train times.
events.source: Colorado Mama Life (IG Oct 8 Halloween list); coloradorailroadmuseum.org

events.title: Mines Museum Spooktacular
events.place: Mines Museum of Earth Science, Golden
events.note: Free teal-pumpkin trick-or-treat with STEM activities, prizes, face painting, and spooky exhibits.
events.source: Mines Museum / Visit Golden

events.title: Puppies & Pumpkins
events.note: Family fall puppy-adoption event with pumpkins and activities (Soul Dog Rescue). Confirm details with the organizer.
events.source: Colorado Mama Life (IG Oct 8 Halloween list); web listing

events.title: Safe Street Halloween
events.place: E.M. Wyatt Centennial Park, 301 Kennedy Dr, Northglenn
events.note: Free Northglenn Police event: trick-or-treat street on Kennedy Dr with inflatables, music, and trunk-or-treat cars; Haunted Mansion theme. Outdoors and busy (about 5,000 kids), so plan time to park at Northglenn Marketplace.
events.source: Colorado Mama Life (IG Oct 7, NORTH edition); northglenn.org

events.title: Westy Fest
events.place: Westminster City Park, 10455 N Sheridan Blvd
events.note: Free fall festival with carnival games, trick-or-treating, live music, pumpkin patch, and hot-air-balloon glow; parking is limited, so use a shuttle if possible.
events.source: City of Westminster

events.title: Harvest Hoot
events.place: Children's Museum of Denver, 2121 Children's Museum Dr
events.note: Costumes welcome; Monster Mash Circus, sensory sand potions, carnival games, cranberry bog. Included with admission (members free); tickets day-of only. No trick-or-treating.
events.source: Colorado Mama Life (IG Oct 8 Halloween list); Colorado Parent / museum listing

events.title: SCFD Free Admission Day at Four Mile
events.note: Free admission to the historic farm park. Days.in.denver flagged that the date in her reel was wrong; the caption and Four Mile’s calendar both say Oct 23.
events.source: Four Mile Historic Park / Days.in.denver

events.title: BOOmar at Belmar
events.place: The Plaza at Belmar, 439 S Upham St, Lakewood
events.note: Free: face painting, balloon twisting, crafts, costume parade, trick-or-treating at Belmar shops.
events.source: Colorado Mama Life; belmarcolorado.com

events.title: Crawl-O-Ween at Butterfly Pavilion
events.note: Indoor costume trick-or-treating with candy and toy stations. Also Oct 31. Adults $25, kids 2–12 $19, under 2 free.
events.source: Colorado Kids Explore; butterflies.org

events.title: Trick or Treat Street at Larimer Square
events.note: Free; candy from participating businesses, costume contest, fall activities, photo booth.
events.source: Colorado Mama Life (IG Oct 8 Halloween list); larimersquare.com

events.title: Halloween Boo and Bounce
events.note: Halloween party at the Highlands indoor play space for babies and toddlers; book through the site.
events.source: Colorado Mama Life (IG Oct 8 Halloween list, as 'Tumble HAUS Halloween Bash'); tumblehaus.com

events.title: BOOnion Station
events.note: Free: mini train on the North Plaza, face painting, DJ, costume contest, trick-or-treating at station businesses.
events.source: Colorado Mama Life; denverunionstation.com

events.title: Trick-or-Treat Street
events.note: Free indoor trick-or-treating with candy and non-candy treats plus activities on each floor; no registration listed.
events.source: Denver Public Library / Days.in.denver

events.title: Hyland Hills Halloween Spooktacular
events.place: Adventure Golf & Raceway, 9650 Sheridan Blvd, Westminster
events.note: Free, ages 12 and under: trick-or-treat stations along three mini-golf courses. Evening, so best right after dinner.
events.source: Colorado Mama Life (IG Oct 7, NORTH edition); hylandhills.org

events.title: Olde Town Trick or Treat Street
events.note: Family trick-or-treating along Olde Town; Friday before Halloween.
events.source: Olde Town Arvada

events.title: Crawl-O-Ween at Butterfly Pavilion (Halloween)
events.note: Halloween-day session of the indoor trick-or-treat. Under 2 free.
events.source: Colorado Kids Explore; butterflies.org

events.title: Monster Mash
events.time: Afternoon; confirm time (Colorado Mama Life lists 2–4 PM)
events.place: Golden History Museum & Park, 923 10th St, Golden
events.note: Free drop-in Halloween party with crafts, stories, and trick-or-treating around downtown Golden spots.
events.source: Colorado Mama Life; goldenhistory.org

events.title: DreamLab Opening Day at Longmont Museum
events.note: Free grand reopening; DreamLab permanent children's gallery opens. After Oct 17, regular museum admission (~$12 adults / $5 children).
events.source: Colorado Mama Life IG Oct 12; City of Longmont

events.title: Highlands Harvest Festival & Trick-or-Treat Street
events.place: W 32nd Ave between Julian St and Newton St, Denver Highlands
events.note: Free costume contest, pumpkin patch, jump castle, kids' games, live music, beer garden, trick-or-treating at neighborhood businesses. From Days.in.denver Fall guide; confirmed on Highland Square site.
events.source: Days.in.denver Fall 2026 guide; visitdenverhighlands.com

events.title: Haunted Trail Adventure
events.place: Bear Creek Lake Park, 15600 W Morrison Rd, Lakewood
events.note: Owl Trail stories/critters, carnival games, treats, then amphitheater s'mores & hot chocolate. Advance registration required (no walk-ins). From Days.in.denver Fall guide; confirmed on City of Lakewood.
events.source: Days.in.denver Fall 2026 guide; lakewoodco.gov

events.title: Magic of the Jack O'Lanterns
events.time: Evening ticketed entry (times vary by date); daytime garden free / unlit
events.place: Hudson Gardens, 6115 S Santa Fe Dr, Littleton
events.note: Nighttime carved-pumpkin walk, ticketed, through Nov 1. Daytime garden stroll free (displays not lit). Gardens close 4:30 PM on event nights (CKAR). Confirm nightly schedule/tickets on Hudson Gardens.
events.source: Colorado Kids Are Rad + Colorado Kids Explore IG Oct 12; Days.in.denver Fall guide

events.title: Howl-o-ween at The Golden Mill
events.place: The Golden Mill, 1012 Ford St, Golden
events.note: 5th annual costume afternoon for dogs, kids, and families: pet parade, live music (Wild Goose Chase), adoptable dogs, and a best kid costume prize. Free to attend; food hall purchases extra (18% service fee).
events.source: Colorado Mama Life IG Oct 16 free Halloween weekend list; confirmed on thegoldenmill.com and visitgolden.com

events.title: Market in the Park-et Halloween Spook-tacular
events.place: Washington Park Boathouse, 701 S Franklin St, Denver
events.note: Free all-ages outdoor market with 70+ local vendors, food trucks, and DJs; costumes encouraged. More of a stroller wander than a kid activity, but the park and lake are right there. Free parking per organizer.
events.source: Colorado Mama Life IG Oct 16 free Halloween weekend list; confirmed on marketintheparket.com and Eventbrite

events.title: Trunk-or-Treat at Golden Corral Thornton
events.place: Golden Corral, 9751 Grant St, Thornton, CO 80229
events.note: Free trunk-or-treat in the restaurant parking lot. Time comes from Colorado Mama Life's list; the restaurant's own posts mention the Oct 17 date but no time was found on an organizer page, so confirm before going.
events.source: Colorado Mama Life IG Oct 16 free Halloween weekend list

events.title: Mythic Creatures: Dragons, Unicorns & Mermaids at DMNS
events.time: Museum hours 9 AM–5 PM daily (most Fridays to 9 PM)
events.place: Denver Museum of Nature & Science, 2001 Colorado Blvd, Denver
events.note: New temporary exhibit included with general admission (free for members), with a mythical-creature dress-up area. Pair with the Nature Play park out back.
events.source: Days.in.denver IG Oct 16 reel; dmns.org

events.title: Skynets Over Downtown floating ribbon art (final weeks)
events.place: Skyline Park (1127 17th St) and Glenarm Plaza (500 16th St), Denver
events.note: Free floating ribbon canopies that ripple in the wind: Skyline Drift at Skyline Park and Quaking Gold at Glenarm Plaza, on view through Nov 8 (the Union Station piece already came down). Fun stroller stop for a toddler who likes looking up.
events.source: Little Rad Adventure IG Oct 17 reel; Denver Arts & Venues

events.title: Halloween Paint + Potions at Space DNVR
events.place: Space DNVR, 3810 Pierce St, Suite C, Wheat Ridge
events.note: Black-light glow paint on the walls, a take-home sensory potion station, and glow face painting. For kids of all ages plus parents; $50 for one parent + one child, $10 per extra family member 2 and up. Tickets are limited. Glow paint is harder to wash out of costumes.
events.source: Colorado Kids Are Rad IG Oct 19 reel (Space DNVR); spacednvr.com
